decisive_items: An incisional biopsy suggested myositis with lymphoid hyperplasia
response.rationale: The biopsy directly supports myositis, overriding the provisional malignancy differential which was based on clinical/imaging features alone.

rejected.why: The provisional malignancy and sarcoma differential are contradicted by the incisional biopsy suggesting myositis.
The lymphoma differential is contradicted by the incisional biopsy suggesting myositis with lymphoid hyperplasia.
